dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: A quick look at how the store is doing: sales, number of orders and the latest orders.
steps: Check the numbers at the top for today's and recent sales.
Scroll to the chart to see sales over time.
Use the side menu to open any section.
tips: Open it every morning to see new orders waiting to be confirmed.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Every product in the store: add, edit, delete, and see what's left.
steps: Click "Add product" for a new one.
Click "Edit" next to a product to change its price, photos or stock.
A red "Sold out" badge means it's completely gone; "Sold out: M, Black" means some sizes or colors are.
The numbers next to the stock show how many of each color and size.
tips: Instead of deleting a sold-out product, keep it — customers see it marked sold out at the end of the list (or hide sold-out items in Site content).

productForm.title: Add / edit product
productForm.intro: Everything about one product: name, price, photos, colors, sizes and stock.
steps: Write the Arabic name and description (English is optional).
Set the price, and a discount % if it's on sale (20 = 20% off).
Pick the category.
Choose the sizes and colors it comes in.
In the "Sizes for each color" grid, enter how many you have of each — leave 0 for a size that color doesn't come in.
Upload photos; you can link a photo to each color.
Save.
tips: "Mark sizes/colors as sold out" stops selling them right away, even if stock says otherwise.
The first photo is the main one; the second shows when a shopper hovers the product.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Every order from the site and the shop. Confirm, update the status, print invoices, and refund or exchange items here.
steps: Search by invoice number, name, phone, email, discount code or seller.
Click an order to open it.
Set the status to "Confirmed" and press "Update & send" — stock is taken on confirm and the customer is emailed.
Once shipped, move it to "Shipped" then "Delivered" — the customer sees this on the Track order page.
To return or swap an item: press "Refund" or "Exchange" on that line, choose how many (and the new product), confirm — it tells you how much to give back or collect.
"Print invoice" opens a ready-to-print invoice.
tips: Cancelling an order puts the items back in stock and takes back the customer's points automatically.
Cash on delivery: press "Mark paid" when the money arrives.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Everyone with an account, with their order count and points.
steps: Search by name, email or phone.
Click a customer to see all their orders, how much they've spent and how many pieces.
Each order shows its items with color and size.
tips: Orders they placed as a guest with the same email show up in their history too.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The store's sections — T-shirts, pants, jackets — shown in the menu, the shop and the home page.
steps: Type the Arabic and English name and add it.
Edit or delete any category from the list.
When adding a product, choose its category so it shows in the right section.
tips: A category's photo on the home page is taken automatically from its first product.

content.title: Site content
content.intro: Change the site's text and images without code, and see each change live in the preview before saving.
steps: Edit any text or upload an image — the preview updates right away.
Use the phone/tablet/desktop and AR/EN buttons to see it as customers will.
Switch home page sections on or off under "Home page sections".
Fill in the store info (phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, address) for the footer and invoices.
Press "Save" under each page — nothing changes for customers until you do.
tips: The return policy prints on invoices only — type - to hide it.

inStoreSale.title: In-store sale
inStoreSale.intro: Ring up a sale for a customer in the shop — taken from the same stock as the site right away, with a printed invoice.
steps: Choose the seller (عبدالله, عمير, or type another name).
Pick the product, then color and size, the quantity, and press "Add to ticket".
Repeat for every piece they're buying.
Optionally add the customer's name, then press "Ring up sale".
The invoice opens straight away — press Print.
tips: "Today in store" shows each seller's sales today.
Made a mistake? Open the sale in Orders and refund or exchange it.

codes.title: Discount codes
codes.intro: Create codes customers type at checkout to get a discount.
steps: Press "Generate" for a random code, or type your own (like ENZO10).
Enter the discount and choose % or ₪.
Optional: minimum order, how many uses, and an expiry date.
Press "Create code", copy it and share it.
Turn any code off or delete it at any time.
tips: The discount is on items only, not delivery.
If an order that used a code is cancelled, that use is given back automatically.

admins.title: Admins
admins.intro: Who can open this control panel.
steps: Type the person's email and press "Make admin".
If they have an account, they're an admin right away.
If not, press "Send invite email", or ask them to sign up and add them again.
Press "Remove" to take access away — their customer account stays.
tips: You can't remove yourself or the last admin, so the store can never be locked out.
